1981-2415-2811-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2811-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1251-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-1734-2150.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4377-7757-7758-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4377-7757-7758-7843.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Elrond.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-5902-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Innkeeper's Talent
Repeat.

2060-4893-5140-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2060-4893-5140-7803.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-7803.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-1169-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-1169-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1621-1895-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4872-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
4872-7443.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
4872-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
4872-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

703-4264-7149.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Altered Ego dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Altered Ego enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Altered Egos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Altered Ego tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4264-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

240-969-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

1308-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-6972-7158.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2150-2281-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

539-1090-7038.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Toph.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Restoration Angel as it's a land due to Ashaya.
Since zero mana was spent to cast Toph, Restoration Angel becomes a 0/0 creature and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Toph triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-2510-4331-4993.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1805-2510-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

549-1978-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
549-1978-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat

3652-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-4699-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

586-4790-5542.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

4050-5544-5933.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Popular Egotist triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

4222-4758-4893-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
4222-4758-4893-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

997-1778-5220-5683.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2921-3197-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
2921-3197-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
2921-3197-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Beast.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

5189-5212-5231.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
5189-5212-5231.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Kresh the Bloodbraided triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kresh the Bloodbraided.
Repeat.

1202-4659-5003-5111.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers twice.
Resolve both Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Nim Deathmantle trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3010-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Moonblade Shinobi does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
3010-3489-3542.description:
Declare Moonblade Shinobi as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moonblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moonblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moonblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3398-3699-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Cadira does not have summoning sickness.
Cadira and Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least seven tokens.
3398-3699-5231.description:
Declare Cadira and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cadira.
Cadira triggers, creating at least seven 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Cadira and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability seven times by sacrificing seven Rabbits, adding seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
If you control eight or more tokens when Cadira deals combat damage, this combo nets infinite Rabbit tokens and red mana.

141-3551-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that can attack this turn.
141-3551-4499.description:
Declare at three creatures you control as attackers.
Holding priority, cast Dragonrage by paying {2}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Dragonrage.
Resolve the copy of Dragonrage, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
If you attack with four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite red mana, and you may activate the abilities of the attacking creatures to give them infinite power until end of turn.

2034-3783-4300.description:
Optionally, activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Illusion token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2144-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Myrkul triggers, causing you to exile Devoted Druid and create a token copy of Devoted Druid that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
Activate the Devoted Druid token's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

1938-2781-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Glorious Protector.
Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield without using the stack due to Glorious Protector leaving the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector and Felidar Guardian enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve Glorious Protector's trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and any number of other non-Angel creatures you control until Guardian Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve Felidar's trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.
